sources.name: Incident Metrics in SRE — Štěpán Davidovič (Google SRE / O'Reilly)
sources.notes: Authority for the MTTx distributional caveat: incident durations are heavy-tailed; means are 'poorly suited for decision making or trend analysis'. Recommends percentiles and incident frequency/rate as replacements.

sources.name: Alerting on SLOs — Google SRE Workbook
sources.notes: Source for burn-rate thresholds: '2% budget consumption in one hour and 5% budget consumption in six hours as reasonable starting numbers for paging.' Used in references/slo-incident-triggering.md.

sources.name: Howie Post-Incident Guide — PagerDuty
sources.notes: Open standard for structured post-incident review. Covers narrative framing, structured interviews, near-miss inclusion, and human-factors lens. Added to references/postmortem-facilitation.md as the named standard for SEV1/SEV2 reviews.

sources.name: Automated Postmortems 2025: incident.io vs FireHydrant vs PagerDuty
sources.notes: Source for 2025–26 declare-and-mobilize process expectations: auto-create incident channel, automated role assignment, status-page automation, auto postmortem doc at close. Used in SKILL.md Workflow section. Framed as process design, not a product endorsement.

sources.name: Grafana OnCall OSS in maintenance mode / archival notice
sources.notes: Grafana OnCall OSS entered maintenance mode 2025-03-11; the OSS Cloud Connection was shut down and the GitHub repo archived 2026-03-24. Grafana now directs teams to Grafana Cloud IRM (merges OnCall + Incident). Used in SKILL.md Fact-Checking tooling-landscape note.

sources.name: Freshworks completes FireHydrant acquisition
sources.notes: Freshworks closed its ~$88.7M acquisition of FireHydrant on 2026-01-01 per Freshworks' Q1 2026 10-Q; FireHydrant now sits inside the Freshservice portfolio. Used in SKILL.md Fact-Checking tooling-landscape note. Verify current FireHydrant product positioning before recommending it as standalone.

sources.name: PagerDuty Jeli UI end-of-life notice
sources.notes: PagerDuty is retiring the standalone Jeli UI (EOL 2026-12-22); Howie-based post-incident review capability is being folded into PagerDuty's native Post-Incident Reviews product. The Howie methodology/guide itself (howie-guide.pagerduty.com) is unaffected and remains the named standard in postmortem-facilitation.md.

sources.name: DORA Article 19 — Reporting of major ICT-related incidents
sources.notes: Confirms the triple cascade: 4-hour initial notification after classification as 'major' (with a 24-hour backstop from detection if classification is delayed), 72-hour intermediate report, 1-month final report. Templates harmonized by RTS 2025/301 and ITS 2024/2956. Used in SKILL.md Regulatory Reporting Overlays section.

sources.name: NIS2 Directive Article 23 — Reporting obligations
sources.notes: Confirms the 24-hour early warning / 72-hour incident notification / 1-month final report cascade, with the clock starting on awareness of a significant incident rather than on internal severity classification (contrast with DORA's classification-triggered clock). Used in SKILL.md Regulatory Reporting Overlays section.

sources.name: SEC Item 1.05 Form 8-K cybersecurity incident disclosure
sources.notes: Confirms the 4-business-day filing deadline runs from the registrant's determination that an incident is material, not from discovery; materiality determination itself must be made without unreasonable delay. Used in SKILL.md Regulatory Reporting Overlays section.
